cases.situation: 2 years at a logistics startup. When my lead left in March I took over warehouse scheduling and cut overtime by about $40k. I'm on $72k, the market for this role looks like $85k. Need to message my manager Kevin on Slack to set up the talk.
cases.reply: Hi Kevin, could we set aside 30 minutes next week to talk about my role and compensation? The scope has grown a lot since I took over warehouse scheduling in March, and I'd like to give it proper time rather than squeeze it into our regular 1:1. Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon both work for me.
cases.note: Book first, ask in the room: bring the $40k overtime saving and the $85k figure to the meeting, not to Slack.

cases.situation: Hatte heute mein Gespräch mit meiner Chefin Frau Albers wegen der Beförderung zur Teamleiterin ab 1. Januar. Sie will das mit dem Geschäftsführer Herrn Brandt besprechen, hat aber kein Datum genannt. Ich (Jana Keller) habe dieses Jahr die drei neuen Kolleginnen eingearbeitet und will eine Follow-up-Mail schreiben.
cases.reply: Liebe Frau Albers, vielen Dank für das offene Gespräch heute. Zur Bestätigung: Sie besprechen die Beförderung zur Teamleiterin zum 1. Januar mit Herrn Brandt. Könnten Sie mir bis zum 30. Oktober Bescheid geben? Bis Freitag schicke ich Ihnen noch die Übersicht zur Einarbeitung der drei neuen Kolleginnen, falls sie für das Gespräch hilft. Viele Grüße, Jana Keller
cases.note: Das Datum für die Antwort steht in der Mail, auch wenn es im Gespräch gefehlt hat.

cases.situation: I'm a UX designer and asked my manager Nadia for 8% after leading the checkout redesign. She said 'not this cycle, let's see next year' without saying what would change it. Our next review is in March and I don't want to just drop it.
cases.reply: Understood, Nadia, and thanks for being straight with me. So I'm clear: what would need to be true for the 8% to be a yes? Could we write down the two or three things you'd want to see from me and look at it again in the March review? I'll put a note in both our calendars.
cases.note: A vague 'next year' becomes written criteria and a date. If you still can't get either, that tells you the ceiling here.

cases.situation: My company just published salary bands. I'm a senior analyst on $68,000 and the band for my level is $74,000 to $88,000. I lead the pricing model now. Want to raise it with my manager Laura without sounding accusatory.
cases.reply: Hi Laura, now that the pay bands are published, I noticed my salary of $68,000 sits below the $74,000 to $88,000 band for senior analyst. I'd like to understand how my pay was set, and whether we can bring it to $78,000, given I now own the pricing model. Could we find 30 minutes next week to talk it through? Thursday or Friday afternoon both work.
cases.note: Anchor on the published band and your scope, never on a colleague's pay, and name the number you want.

cases.situation: 我在一家跨境电商公司做数据分析三年，月薪1.8万。去年搭了广告投放的归因看板，获客成本降了约15%，现在也在带新人。上周拿到另一家公司2.4万的offer，要在10月12号前回复。我更想留下，想跟领导王姐谈加薪，怎么提这个offer才不像威胁？
cases.reply: 王姐，我很喜欢现在的工作，也想在这个团队长期做下去。过去一年我搭了广告投放的归因看板，投放组的获客成本降了大约15%，新人的数据培训现在也是我在带。坦白说，上周我拿到了另一家公司月薪2.4万的offer，但我更想留下，所以想先跟您谈：能不能把我的月薪调到2.3万？需要什么材料往上申请，我这周都可以准备。那边要我10月12日前答复，所以想请您10月9日周五前给我一个结果。
cases.note: 外部offer只提一次，语气平静，先说想留下；只有真的会去才提，否则就别拿它当筹码。

cases.situation: Sous chef at a 30-seat restaurant, 3 years. Since our head chef left in June I've written the menus and done all the ordering, food cost went from 34% to 29%. I want the head chef title and $62k (I'm on $51k). Owner Marco runs everything; I want to text him to set up the talk.
cases.reply: Hi Marco, could we sit down for 30 minutes before service this week, Wednesday or Thursday around 2? I'd like to talk about my role since June, with the menus and the ordering, and where it goes from here, including title and pay. I love this kitchen and want to keep building it with you, so I'd rather do this properly than mid-shift.
cases.note: The booking text names the topic so it isn't an ambush; save the food-cost numbers and the $62k for the meeting itself.

cases.situation: In March my manager Rob said if I delivered the data platform migration I'd be put up for Staff Engineer in the fall cycle. It went live on August 18. Now he says I also need to 'show more cross-org influence'. It feels like the goalposts moved. We have a 1:1 on Thursday.
cases.reply: Thanks for being straight with me about where it stands. In March we agreed that shipping the data platform migration was the bar for Staff this fall, and it went live on 18 August. Since the criteria have shifted, could we write down exactly what's needed now, what cross-org influence looks like in practice, and the date you'll decide, so we're both working to the same list? I'd like it settled in time for the fall cycle.
cases.note: Name the original agreement as a fact, not an accusation, and get the new bar in writing with a date. If it moves again, that tells you the ceiling here.

cases.situation: 我在一家设计公司做了四年，今年三月开始带小吴和小赵两个新人，审他们的稿，上季度组里准时交付率从80%提到了95%。上周刘总说给我升设计组长，但工资不变，明年再看。我月薪1.5万，公司其他组长大概1.8万，明天约了他谈。
cases.reply: 刘总，谢谢您给我这个机会，组长这个角色我很想做好。从三月开始我已经在带小吴和小赵，他们的稿子都是我审，上个季度组里的准时交付率从80%提到了95%。升组长之后责任和范围都变了，我希望薪资同步调整到1.8万，和公司其他组长一致。如果现在调不了，我们能不能把条件和时间定下来，比如明年一月的调薪就按这个执行？
cases.note: 晋升是头衔、职责加薪资；只给头衔时不要直接接受，先谈薪资，谈不下来就把条件和日期写下来。

cases.situation: My new manager Aisha started six weeks ago and doesn't know my history. I'm a customer success lead on $64k; since January I've owned our 14 enterprise accounts (about $2.1M a year) with a 96% renewal rate, and I wrote the onboarding playbook the team uses. Similar roles pay about $70k to $78k. I want $72k before the November review cycle. We meet Thursday.
cases.reply: Thanks for making time, Aisha. I really like this team and want to keep growing here, and since you're new I wanted to give you the full picture before the November cycle. Since January I've owned our 14 enterprise accounts, about $2.1M a year, with a 96% renewal rate, and I wrote the onboarding playbook the team uses now. Based on that scope and what CS leads are paid in the market, I'd like to move from $64,000 to $72,000. What would you need from me to make that case in November?
cases.note: A new manager can't vouch for your history, so give her the case in numbers she can repeat upstairs, and send it in writing the same day.

cases.situation: I've been a nanny for the Carters' two kids, Leo (8) and Maya (6), for two years at $20 an hour. Since September I also do school pickup and homework help, and Maya's reading has come on a lot. Local rates for that scope are $22 to $25. I want to ask their mum, Lucy, for $23 an hour from November. We've set up a chat Thursday evening.
cases.reply: Lucy, I really love working with you and the kids and I'd like to keep doing it for a long time. Since September I've taken on school pickup and homework as well as childcare, and Maya's reading has really come on. Based on that and what nannies with this scope earn around here, I'd like to move to $23 an hour from November. What do you think, and if it's not possible now, what would it take?
cases.note: A household employer is still an employer: commitment first, scope and results as evidence, one number, and an invitation to the path.

cases.situation: 我在一家SaaS公司做测试工程师三年，月薪1.6万，去年搭了接口自动化测试，回归时间从两天缩到半天。最近在带一个同职级的新同事，无意中知道他月薪1.9万。招聘网站上同职级大概1.8万到2万。明天约了领导陈总谈，不想拿同事说事。
cases.reply: 陈总，谢谢您抽时间。我很喜欢这里的工作，也想在测试这块继续做深。过去一年我搭了接口自动化测试，回归时间从两天缩到了半天；这个季度的新同事也是我在带。我看了一下，同职级测试工程师的市场薪资在1.8万到2万之间，我希望把月薪调到1.9万。如果现在调不了，需要满足哪些条件、什么时候能再看？
cases.note: 同事的工资只是提醒你该谈了，不是论据；在谈话里只讲自己的成果、职级和市场数据，永远不点名比较。

cases.situation: In August my manager Tom agreed my raise from $70k to $78k from September 1, and HR sent a confirmation letter on August 21. My September payslip still shows $70k, and Tom has said 'HR is on it' twice in two weeks. I want to follow up in writing without sounding pushy.
cases.reply: Hi Tom, following up on my raise to $78,000 from 1 September, confirmed in HR's letter of 21 August. My September payslip still shows $70,000, so I was paid about $667 short before tax. Could you or HR confirm by Friday 2 October that the October payroll will include the new salary and the September back pay? Happy to forward the letter and the payslip if that helps.
cases.note: Once a raise is agreed, the follow-up is admin: the letter, the gap, one dated ask. If October passes, go to HR directly with both documents.

cases.situation: I asked my manager Denise for $82k (I'm on $70k), the market rate for this scope, after taking over our two biggest client accounts. She emailed back today offering $75k from January, saying it's what she could get approved. I want to take it but not drop the rest.
cases.reply: Thanks, Denise, I appreciate you getting it approved and coming back so quickly. I'm glad to accept $75,000 from January. I'd still like to close the gap to $82,000, since that's where this scope sits in the market. Could we agree in writing what you'd need to see from me by the July review to get there?
cases.note: Accept what's on the table, keep your number, and turn the rest into written criteria with a date.

cases.situation: I came back in August from nine months of parental leave. Before I left, my manager Sophie said I was 'on track' for Senior Account Manager, but the spring promotion cycle ran while I was out and I wasn't considered. I want to book a talk about it without sounding resentful.
cases.reply: Hi Sophie, now that I'm properly settled back in, could we find 30 minutes in the next two weeks to talk about my path to Senior Account Manager? Before my leave we'd agreed I was on track, and since the spring cycle ran while I was out, I'd like us to pin down what's needed for the next one and when it is. Tuesday or Thursday afternoon would suit me.
cases.note: Book the talk about the path, not the grievance, and bring your pre-leave results to the meeting. If the path keeps moving, check your company's leave policy and talk to HR.

cases.situation: Llevo cuatro años trabajando en la ferretería de mi tío Paco en Valencia y cobro 1.450 euros al mes. Desde enero llevo yo los pedidos a proveedores y la tienda online, que ya es el 20% de las ventas. Hemos quedado el sábado después de cerrar y quiero pedirle 1.700 euros sin que se convierta en una conversación de familia.
cases.reply: Paco, hoy quiero hablar contigo como jefe, no como sobrino. Me gusta mucho la tienda y quiero seguir aquí muchos años. Desde enero llevo los pedidos a proveedores y la tienda online, que ya es el 20% de las ventas. Por eso te pido pasar de 1.450 a 1.700 euros al mes a partir de noviembre. Si ahora no es posible, ¿qué necesitarías ver y cuándo lo podemos revisar?
cases.note: Con un familiar como jefe, separa los papeles en la primera frase y apóyate solo en el trabajo, nunca en la familia.

cases.situation: My director Hannah just asked if I'll take over the Northern region team when Raj leaves on October 16, on top of my own team, so 12 people instead of 6. I'm a regional manager on $95k and want to say yes, but the doubled scope should come with a title and pay change.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, thanks for trusting me with this, and yes, I'd like to take on the Northern team. Going from 6 people to 12 across two regions is a real change in the role, so alongside the handover plan I'd like us to talk about the title and pay that go with it. Could we find 30 minutes before Raj leaves on Friday 16 October? Thursday or Friday afternoon this week both work for me.
cases.note: The moment scope is added is the best time to ask: say yes, name the change, and book the pay talk before the handover. Bring the number to the meeting.

cases.situation: I'm a programme coordinator at a small charity on £31,000. In July my director Helen said salaries are frozen until April because of a funding cut. Since my colleague Sam left in July and wasn't replaced, I've run the volunteer programme (60 volunteers) on top of my own job. I'd like the title Programme and Volunteer Manager now and £35,000 from April, agreed in writing.
cases.reply: Hi Helen, could we find 30 minutes next week to talk about my role? I love working here and want to keep growing with the charity. Since Sam left in July I've been running the volunteer programme, all 60 volunteers, alongside my coordinator work. I understand salaries are frozen until April, so I'd like to propose the title Programme and Volunteer Manager now, and a written agreement that my salary moves to £35,000 in April. If that's not possible, I'd like to understand what would be.
cases.note: When cash is frozen, ask for the title now and lock the number in writing for the date the freeze ends.

cases.situation: I'm Leila, a marketing analyst at a logistics company for two years, on $72k. My manager Tom has my annual review on Thursday Oct 8. Since my last raise I took over the $400k-a-year paid ads budget after a colleague left, and similar roles are posting at $82k to $88k. I want to email him before the review asking for $85k.
cases.reply: Hi Tom, I'm looking forward to Thursday's review, and I've really enjoyed this year on the team. Since I took over the $400k paid ads budget, my role has grown a lot, and similar roles are currently posting at $82k to $88k. I'd like to discuss moving my salary from $72k to $85k. Could we make that part of Thursday's conversation? If the full amount is hard this cycle, I'm open to talking about timing or a title that reflects the budget too. Thanks, Leila
cases.note: Sent ahead so Tom can check budget before the meeting instead of reacting on the spot.
